value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A fever with spots that do not fade when pressed is treated as an emergency, even if your child looks well. Please do not wait to see if it changes.
value.triage: Call 911 now if your child is drowsy, hard to wake, floppy, breathing fast, has a stiff neck, or the spots are spreading. Otherwise go to the ER right now. Do not wait for a call to 811 - this is not a watch-and-wait situation.
